evidence: View_SwitchCamera calls it first on the active record with the next one; dispatches by camera type to the car / trackside leave handlers.
View_SwitchCamera calls it on the next record (with the active one) before Camera_Start; types 4/5 copy the camera basis, 3 resets the driver pose, 1/2/10 and 7 set the car lift.
Called on the previous record when the switch (or its blend) completes; an interior camera (type 3) turns the interior render mode off.
Called on the new record when the switch (or its blend) completes; type 3 turns the interior render mode on, 1/2/10 and chase-like 7 give the car full lift.
Last call of a completed switch on the previous record: for an interior camera (type 3) it calls the empty RallyData_ValidateIndex.
Camera_EndLeave handler of type 3: CGame::SetObjectRenderMode(0) when the record's car has an interior root.
Camera_EndEnter handler of type 3: CGame::SetObjectRenderMode(1) when the record's car has an interior root.
Camera_BeginLeave handler of types 1/2/10: sets g_viewCarLift of the record from the next camera's type (and full lift for the next one on 1 -> 2).
Camera_BeginEnter handler of types 1/2/10: g_viewCarLift[record] = 1.0 when the other camera is also car-mounted (1/2/10), else 0.
g_viewCarLift[record] = 1.0; Camera_EndEnter handler of type 2.
Camera_EndEnter handler of types 1/10: no-op glow callback for the other record, then g_viewCarLift[record] = 1.0.
Camera_BeginLeave handler of type 7: only for a spot whose heading is near +/-0x400 (a chase-like spot), CarCamera_BeginLeave.
Camera_BeginEnter handler of type 7: when the other record uses a chase-like spot (heading near +/-0x400), CarCamera_BeginEnter on the other record.
Camera_EndEnter handler of type 7: for a chase-like spot (heading near +/-0x400), CarCamera_EndEnter.
Moves g_tracksideAims[record] towards g_tracksideAimTargets by the step (locks on when closer); the aim is what View_BuildTracksideCameraMatrix looks at.
Moves g_tracksideZooms[record] towards g_tracksideZoomTargets by the step; the zoom becomes CameraRecord::zoom in View_BuildTracksideCameraMatrix.
Adds the step to g_tracksideDollyProgress (clamped to 1.0), the fraction of the spot's dolly track View_BuildTracksideCameraMatrix moves along.
Aim target = car position + smoothed speed lead; zoom target blended from CameraSpot::zoom to zoomAtRange by distance / range.
Spot right axis minus the car's velocity direction, scaled by car speed * CameraSpot::speedScale: the lead added to the aim point.
Stores g_viewFarPlanes[view], the far plane View_SetPlayerProjection passes to CGraphics::SetProjection.
